title: Wallet Stack
description: Wallet of stacked cards where only each top edge peeks out, with recent transactions underneath.
steps: `orientation="vertical"` with `itemSize` 120: `itemAnimation` shows the current card in full and each later card 52 pt lower, covering the one before.
Passed cards tuck 16 pt up behind it, shrink to 0.84 and fade, and tapping a card calls `scrollTo({ index })`.
Autoplay deals a card every 2200 ms and `onSnapToItem` flips `autoplayDirection` at both ends, while `progress` keeps the transaction list under the last card.
